comment: The qemu-ios commit the iOS emulator is built from, and that ios/patches/qemu-ios apply to. Its own pin, not build-support/sources.json's (the Mac app's), so an upstream merge never moves the emulator under the patches. To move it: rebase every patch onto the new commit (all must apply in order, as ios/scripts/build-qemu.sh requires), then change this line.
